newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac says Eurotunnel has positive future.
newsitem.headline: Chirac says Eurotunnel has positive future.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac said on Tuesday that he believed the Channel Tunnel had a "positive future".
Anglo-French company Eurotunnel SA /Plc is the operator for the Channel Tunnel and is trying to negotiate a debt restructuring with its bank lenders.

"The future is positive. I believe, little by little, we will see this machinery becoming more profitable," Chirac told reporters on a visit to the Pas-de-Calais region in the north of France. "I am not pessimistic," he said.
Asked about Eurotunnel's current situation, Chirac said he hoped "that everyone will try in his own capacity to assure the success of the the financial recovery being undertaken."
The president of the Paris commercial court is expected to make a statement later on Tuesday on Eurotunnel's debt negotiations.
